name: Reinforced Bow-Frame

pages.text: Combine with a Simply Bows unique bow at an anvil; the component is consumed.

pages.title: Source
pages.text: Search vanilla structure chests, such as shipwreck treasure and village chests. The native handler adds components to Minecraft chest loot tables. Ancient City rune loot has an additional pool; an individual chest need not contain your desired item.

pages.title: Anvil
pages.text: Put a Simply Bows unique bow and this component into the two anvil inputs. Either input order is supported. Take the result and pay the displayed experience cost: the component is consumed and adds a Frame level, increasing the relevant ability damage.

pages.title: Limits
pages.text: The bow has a combined slot cap and a per-type level cap. If a cap prevents changing its data, no result appears. Both limits are five in the current configuration file; the live menu shows the applicable state.

jem_summary: Combine with a Simply Bows unique bow at an anvil; the component is consumed.
